description: This file defines the UserGroup class in the Opencart project, specifically in the admin model for user groups. It includes methods for CRUD operations on user groups and permissions stored in the database.

classes.name: UserGroup
classes.description: A model class managing user groups, providing methods to create, update, delete, retrieve user groups, and manage permissions.

methods.name: addUserGroup
methods.description: Creates a new user group record in the database with provided data, returning the new user group ID.

methods.name: editUserGroup
methods.description: Updates an existing user group identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: deleteUserGroup
methods.description: Deletes a user group record from the database by ID.

methods.name: getUserGroup
methods.description: Fetches a user group's data, decoding permissions from JSON.

methods.name: getUserGroups
methods.description: Retrieves a list of user groups, with optional filtering, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalUserGroups
methods.description: Returns the total count of user groups stored in the database.

methods.name: addPermission
methods.description: Adds a permission route under a specific type for a user group.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes a permission route under a specific type from a user group.
